\caption{Existing models on silent guitar video. Mean over clips (8\,s, or the whole recording if shorter: magcil bends $\approx$3\,s; 25\,fps; only frames with a visible fretboard). F1 in \%, onset tolerance 50/100\,ms; timing F1 ignores pitch; chroma = chroma similarity; onset $r$ = correlation of onset curves; tab rec.\ = share of GuiFiR's manual tablature pitches found as onsets ($\pm$100\,ms). GAPS is scored against real MIDI, GuiFiR-Vid and magcil against the transcription of the real audio (pseudo-GT; its own row is omitted there). Real audio on GAPS = transcription ceiling. MMAudio, ThinkSound, FoleyCrafter: video $\to$ audio, scored via audio transcription; V2N, Audeo: piano video $\to$ MIDI models on the rectified fretboard strip; Foley Music: body and hand keypoints $\to$ MIDI, retrained by us on its own MUSIC guitar data. LoRA: MMAudio with LoRA adapters (rank 16) trained by us on GAPS train video + audio; A with the video, B with the video blanked during training (generated with the video, or without: the same audio for every clip). Chance = real-audio transcription of another piece. $^{*}$ The model is better with the clip's own video than with the video of another piece (paired Wilcoxon, $p<0.05$).}
\label{tab:baseline_results}
